notes: Last level: أبو أيوب speaks the Prophet's saying («إني سمعت رسول الله») inside Asim's story (rule 6); عقبة بن عامر is asked and answers «نعم» to the same saying, so he is written as a co-transmitter at that level (rule 6).
«فقال عاصم يا أبا أيوب» addresses Abu Ayyub and is not an extra link.
